question: What powers belong to one who has offered the self to the goddess-circles on the three tridents?
premises: The practitioner offers the self to the successive goddess-circles on the triad of tridents.
The verse frames the result as a series of rhetorical questions.
Birth, knowledge, and action are all included in the scope of the result.
inference: Such a practitioner is presented as having unrestricted power in becoming, knowing, and doing.
plain_english: For one whose self is offered to the higher and higher circles of goddesses on that triad of tridents, what is not born, what is not known, or what is not done?
